name: Pasta e fagioli
description: A thick, rustic tomato soup of small pasta and creamy white beans.
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the olive oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, broth and beans. Simmer for 15 minutes, then mash a few beans to thicken.
Stir in the cooked pasta and heat through.
Serve topped with parmesan and basil.

name: Baked cod with tomatoes & olives
description: Flaky cod roasted on burst tomatoes, olives and capers, served with couscous.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Toss the tomatoes, olives, capers and garlic with the oil and wine in a baking dish.
Roast for 10 minutes, then nestle in the cod.
Roast for 10–12 minutes more, until the fish flakes and reaches 63 °C (145 °F).
Scatter over the parsley and serve with couscous.

name: Spaghetti al pomodoro
description: The Italian classic: spaghetti in a quick garlic, tomato and basil sauce.
steps: Warm the garlic in the oil until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 12 minutes.
Toss with the cooked spaghetti and a splash of pasta water.
Finish with torn basil and parmesan.

name: Risotto ai funghi
description: Creamy mushroom risotto finished with parmesan and butter.
steps: Brown the mushrooms in the oil and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic, add the rice and toast for 1 minute. Add the wine and let it bubble away.
Add the hot broth a ladle at a time, stirring, for about 18 minutes until creamy.
Stir in the mushrooms, butter and parmesan. Rest for 2 minutes and serve with parsley.

name: Chicken cacciatore
description: Hunter-style chicken braised with peppers, mushrooms, olives, rosemary and wine.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside.
Cook the onion, pepper, mushrooms and garlic for 6 minutes. Add the wine and reduce by half.
Add the tomatoes, olives, rosemary and chicken. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes, until the chicken reaches 74 °C (165 °F).

name: Sardinian longevity minestrone
description: The bean-rich vegetable soup eaten daily in Sardinia's Blue Zone, with fregola-style pasta and pecorino.

ingredients.amount: about 120 g dry fregola or small pasta

steps: Soften the onion, carrot, celery and fennel in the oil for 10 minutes.
Add the potatoes, tomatoes, broth, beans and chickpeas. Simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the cooked pasta and herbs. Serve with pecorino.

name: Espinacas con garbanzos
description: Seville's smoky spinach and chickpea tapa, thickened with garlicky fried bread.
steps: Fry the bread and garlic in the oil until golden, then pound with the spices and vinegar to a paste.
Wilt the spinach, add the chickpeas and the paste with a splash of water.
Simmer for 5 minutes until thick.

name: Tortilla española
description: Thick Spanish potato and onion omelette, golden outside and tender inside.
steps: Cook the potatoes and onion slowly in the oil for 20 minutes until soft but not browned.
Beat the eggs with the salt, fold in the potatoes and rest for 5 minutes.
Cook in a non-stick pan over low heat for 8 minutes, flip onto a plate and cook the other side until set in the middle.

name: Vegetable paella with chickpeas
description: Saffron-yellow rice with peppers, peas, tomato and chickpeas, cooked in one wide pan.

ingredients.amount: a pinch of saffron or turmeric

steps: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in the oil. Add the tomato, paprika and saffron and cook for 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and broth, spread it out evenly and don't stir again. Simmer for 15 minutes.
Scatter over the chickpeas and peas, cover and cook 5 minutes more. Serve with lemon.

name: Gambas al ajillo
description: Sizzling garlic shrimp in olive oil with a little chili, served with bread for dipping.
steps: Warm the oil with the garlic and chili until the garlic is just golden.
Add the shrimp and cook for 2–3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Finish with lemon and parsley. Serve straight from the pan with bread.

name: Mercimek çorbası (red lentil soup)
description: Velvety Turkish lentil soup with cumin, paprika butter-style oil and a squeeze of lemon.
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in half the oil for 8 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste and cumin.
Add the lentils and broth and simmer for 15 minutes, then blend until smooth.
Warm the paprika in the remaining oil and drizzle over. Serve with lemon and bread.

name: Menemen
description: Soft-scrambled eggs cooked into sweet peppers and juicy tomatoes, Istanbul-breakfast style.
steps: Cook the peppers (and onion) in the oil until soft, about 6 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and simmer until most of the liquid has gone.
Stir in the beaten eggs and cook gently until set but still soft; cook fully if you prefer firm eggs. Sprinkle with pepper flakes and serve with bread.

name: Tavuk şiş with bulgur pilaf
description: Yogurt-and-pepper-paste chicken skewers with nutty bulgur pilaf and a crisp shepherd's salad.
steps: Mix the yogurt, tomato paste, paprika, garlic, lemon and half the oil. Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes, chilled.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 10–12 minutes, turning, until 74 °C (165 °F) inside.
Fry the onion in the remaining oil and fold through the bulgur.
Toss the tomato, cucumber and parsley and serve alongside.

name: İmam bayıldı
description: Olive-oil-braised eggplants stuffed with slow-cooked onion, garlic and tomato.
steps: Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh and roast at 200 °C (400 °F) for 20 minutes.
Slowly cook the onions and garlic in the oil for 15 minutes, then add the tomatoes, sugar and parsley.
Press the eggplant flesh open, pile in the filling and bake for 20 minutes more. Serve warm or at room temperature.

name: Kısır with chickpeas
description: Herby, tangy bulgur salad with tomato paste, lemon, mint and chickpeas.
steps: Rub the tomato paste, oil and lemon juice into the bulgur.
Fold in everything else and season to taste. Rest for 10 minutes before serving.

name: Ratatouille
description: Provençal summer vegetables slowly stewed with garlic, thyme and olive oil.
steps: Brown the eggplant and zucchini in batches in two thirds of the oil.
Soften the onion, peppers and garlic in the rest, then add the tomatoes and thyme.
Return the vegetables and simmer gently for 30 minutes. Finish with basil.

name: Salade niçoise
description: The Riviera classic: tuna, potatoes, egg, tomatoes and olives with a sharp vinaigrette.
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender and the eggs for 10 minutes, then cool.
Whisk the oil and vinegar with a pinch of salt.
Arrange everything on a platter and spoon over the dressing.

name: Poulet à la provençale
description: Chicken thighs baked with potatoes, tomatoes, olives, garlic and Provençal herbs.
steps: Heat the oven to 200 °C (400 °F). Toss the potatoes with half the oil and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken, tomatoes, olives, garlic, wine and herbs, drizzle with the rest of the oil.
Roast for 30 minutes, until the chicken reaches 74 °C (165 °F).

name: Warm French lentil salad
description: Puy-style lentils with carrot, celery and shallot in a mustardy vinaigrette, topped with feta.
steps: Soften the carrot and celery in a little of the oil for 5 minutes.
Whisk the rest of the oil with the vinegar and shallot.
Toss the warm lentils with the vegetables, dressing and parsley. Top with feta.

name: Smoked salmon & dill on rye
description: Open-faced rye toasts with cream cheese, cold-smoked salmon, cucumber and dill.

ingredients.amount: a few rings of red onion

steps: Toast the rye bread and spread with cream cheese.
Layer the cucumber and smoked salmon on top.
Finish with onion, dill and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Blueberry & walnut overnight oats
description: Creamy oats soaked overnight with yogurt, blueberries, walnuts and cinnamon.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, honey and cinnamon together in two jars.
Refrigerate overnight (at least 6 hours).
Top with blueberries and walnuts before eating.

name: Barley & mushroom stew
description: A hearty, thyme-scented stew of pearl barley, mushrooms, root vegetables and peas.
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the mushrooms, garlic and thyme and cook until the mushrooms release their liquid.
Add the broth and barley and simmer for 15 minutes. Stir in the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Serve scattered with dill.

name: Salmon with dill potatoes & cucumber salad
description: Oven-baked salmon, buttery dill new potatoes and a quick pickled cucumber salad.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, then toss with the butter and half the dill.
Bake the salmon at 200 °C (400 °F) for 12–14 minutes, until it reaches 63 °C (145 °F).
Toss the cucumber with the vinegar. Stir the rest of the dill and the lemon into the yogurt and serve.

name: Kung pao chicken
description: Sichuan-style chicken with peanuts, peppers and a sweet-sour, chili-flecked glaze.
steps: Toss the chicken with half the cornstarch. Mix the soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, remaining cornstarch and 3 tbsp water.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil until cooked through to 74 °C (165 °F). Remove.
Stir-fry the pepper, zucchini, garlic, ginger and chilies for 3 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the sauce and bubble until glossy. Toss in the peanuts and serve with rice.

name: Garlic shrimp & broccoli stir-fry
description: Juicy shrimp and crisp broccoli in a light garlic-ginger sauce.
steps: Stir-fry the broccoli in half the oil with a splash of water for 3 minutes.
Add the remaining oil, garlic, ginger and shrimp. Cook for 2–3 minutes until the shrimp are pink and opaque.
Mix the soy sauce and cornstarch with 3 tbsp water, pour in and toss until glossy. Serve with rice.

name: Crispy tofu & broccoli stir-fry
description: Golden tofu and broccoli in a sticky maple-soy glaze.
steps: Toss the tofu in the cornstarch and fry in the oil until crisp on all sides.
Add the broccoli, pepper, garlic and ginger with a splash of water. Cook for 4 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and maple syrup and toss until glazed. Serve with rice.

name: Mapo tofu
description: Sichuan soft tofu in a fiery, numbing chili-bean sauce with a little minced pork.
steps: Brown the pork in the oil until no pink remains. Add the chili paste, garlic and ginger.
Add ¾ cup water and the soy sauce, then slide in the tofu and simmer for 5 minutes.
Thicken with the cornstarch mixed in water. Finish with Sichuan pepper and scallions. Serve with rice.

name: Tomato & egg stir-fry
description: China's beloved home dish: fluffy eggs in a sweet-savoury tomato sauce over rice.
steps: Scramble the eggs in half the oil until just set, then remove.
Cook the tomatoes with the sugar and salt until saucy.
Return the eggs, fold through and cook until the eggs are fully set. Top with scallions and serve over rice.

name: Cantonese steamed fish with ginger & scallion
description: Delicate steamed white fish finished with sizzling ginger-scallion oil and soy.
steps: Steam the fish on a plate with half the ginger for 8–10 minutes, until it flakes and reaches 63 °C (145 °F).
Steam the bok choy alongside for the last 3 minutes.
Top the fish with the scallions and remaining ginger, pour over smoking-hot oil, then the soy sauce and sesame oil.

name: Salmon teriyaki with rice & broccoli
description: Glossy soy-ginger glazed salmon with steamed rice and broccoli.
steps: Stir the soy sauce, sake, honey and ginger together.
Sear the salmon in the oil for 3 minutes per side.
Pour in the sauce and bubble until glossy and the salmon reaches 63 °C (145 °F).
Serve with rice and steamed broccoli, sprinkled with sesame seeds.

name: Salmon, avocado & edamame rice bowl
description: Flaked roasted salmon with edamame, cucumber and avocado over rice.
steps: Roast the salmon at 200 °C (400 °F) for 12–14 minutes, until it reaches 63 °C (145 °F). Flake into large pieces.
Season the rice with the vinegar.
Top the rice with salmon, edamame, cucumber and avocado. Drizzle with soy sauce and sprinkle with sesame.

name: Sesame soba & edamame bowl
description: Chilled soba noodles tossed with edamame, crunchy vegetables and sesame dressing.
steps: Cook the soba according to the pack, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar and sesame oil.
Toss the noodles with the edamame, carrot, cucumber and dressing. Top with sesame.

name: Oyakodon
description: Chicken and egg gently simmered in a sweet soy broth over short-grain rice.
steps: Simmer the broth, soy sauce, mirin and sugar with the onion for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook until it reaches 74 °C (165 °F).
Pour over the eggs, cover and cook until set to your liking (fully set if you need firm eggs). Slide over the rice and top with scallions.

name: Miso soup set with tofu, rice & edamame
description: A Japanese home-style set: tofu and wakame miso soup, a bowl of rice and salted edamame.
steps: Heat the broth without boiling. Whisk in the miso.
Add the tofu and wakame and warm through.
Serve topped with scallions, with rice and edamame on the side.

name: Beef bibimbap
description: Rice topped with seasoned beef, vegetables, a fried egg and chili sauce.
steps: Marinate the beef in the soy sauce, half the sesame oil, the garlic and sugar for 15 minutes.
Blanch the spinach and bean sprouts separately until steaming hot. Season with the remaining sesame oil.
Stir-fry the carrot for 2 minutes, then the beef for 3–4 minutes until browned.
Fry the eggs. Arrange everything over the rice and top with chili sauce and sesame.

name: Beef bulgogi with lettuce wraps
description: Sweet, garlicky grilled beef with rice and crisp lettuce to wrap it in.
steps: Marinate the beef with the soy sauce, sugar, garlic and sesame oil for 20 minutes.
Sear with the onion in a very hot pan for 3–4 minutes.
Top with scallions and sesame and serve with rice and lettuce leaves.

name: Sundubu jjigae (soft tofu stew)
description: Bubbling, spicy soft tofu stew with kimchi and zucchini, finished with an egg.
steps: Fry the kimchi, onion, garlic and chili in the sesame oil for 3 minutes.
Add the broth and zucchini and simmer for 5 minutes. Spoon in the tofu in large pieces.
Crack in the eggs and simmer until set. Top with scallions and serve with rice.

name: Kimchi fried rice
description: Tangy, spicy kimchi fried rice topped with a fried egg and sesame.
steps: Fry the onion and kimchi in the canola oil for 4 minutes.
Add the rice, gochujang and soy sauce and stir-fry until hot and lightly crisp.
Finish with sesame oil. Top with fried eggs, scallions and sesame.

name: Goya champuru
description: Okinawa's signature stir-fry of bitter melon, tofu, egg and pork.
steps: Salt the sliced bitter melon for 10 minutes, then rinse to soften the bitterness.
Brown the tofu in half the oil and set aside. Stir-fry the pork until cooked through (no pink remains).
Add the bitter melon for 3 minutes, return the tofu and add the soy sauce.
Pour in the eggs and fold until set. Serve with rice.

name: Okinawan tofu champuru with sweet potato
description: Okinawa's everyday tofu and vegetable stir-fry, served with steamed sweet potato, a traditional staple.
steps: Steam the sweet potato for 20 minutes until tender.
Tear the tofu into chunks and brown in the oil.
Add the cabbage, carrot and sprouts and stir-fry until the sprouts are hot throughout. Season with soy sauce and scallions.

name: Okinawan sweet potato & tofu miso soup
description: A hearty Okinawan-style miso soup with sweet potato, tofu, greens and seaweed, served with rice.
steps: Simmer the sweet potato in the broth for 10 minutes.
Add the tofu, bok choy and wakame and warm through.
Take off the heat, whisk in the miso and top with scallions. Serve with rice.

name: Kufa jūshī (Okinawan mixed rice)
description: Okinawan seasoned rice cooked with mushrooms, carrot and seaweed. This version skips the usual pork and adds edamame.
steps: Stir-fry the mushrooms and carrot in the sesame oil for 3 minutes. Add the soy sauce and seaweed.
Fold the vegetables and edamame through the hot rice, cover and let it steam for 5 minutes.
Top with scallions.

name: Pad kra pao (Thai basil chicken)
description: Fiery minced chicken with garlic, chili and holy basil over rice, with a crispy fried egg.
steps: Pound the garlic and chilies. Fry in the oil for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and pepper and stir-fry until the chicken reaches 74 °C (165 °F). Season with the sauces and sugar.
Toss in the basil. Serve over rice with fried eggs, cooked until the yolks are firm if needed.

name: Thai green curry with chicken
description: Creamy coconut green curry with chicken, eggplant, peppers and Thai basil over jasmine rice.
steps: Fry the curry paste in the oil for 1 minute, then add half the coconut milk and bubble until fragrant.
Add the chicken, the rest of the coconut milk and the eggplant. Simmer for 12 minutes, until the chicken reaches 74 °C (165 °F).
Add the pepper, fish sauce and sugar for 2 minutes. Stir in the basil and serve with rice.

name: Pad thai with tofu
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with tofu, egg, bean sprouts and peanuts in a sweet-sour sauce.
steps: Fry the tofu in the oil until golden. Push aside and scramble the eggs with the garlic.
Add the noodles with the fish sauce, sugar and lime and toss until coated.
Add the sprouts and scallions and stir-fry until hot. Top with peanuts.

name: Tom yum goong
description: Hot and sour Thai shrimp soup with mushrooms, tomato, lime and chili, with jasmine rice.
steps: Simmer the broth with the galangal and chilies for 10 minutes.
Add the mushrooms and tomato for 3 minutes, then the shrimp until pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime off the heat. Top with cilantro and serve with rice.

name: Phở gà (chicken noodle soup)
description: Clear, fragrant chicken broth with rice noodles, charred ginger, cinnamon and fresh herbs.
steps: Simmer the broth with the charred onion, ginger and cinnamon for 25 minutes. Season with fish sauce.
Poach the chicken in the broth until it reaches 74 °C (165 °F), then shred.
Pour the boiling broth over noodles and chicken. Top with herbs, sprouts, scallions and lime.

name: Bún gà nướng (lemongrass-style chicken noodle salad)
description: Grilled caramelised chicken over cool rice noodles, crunchy vegetables, herbs and peanuts with nước chấm.
steps: Marinate the chicken with half the fish sauce and sugar, the garlic and oil. Grill until charred and 74 °C (165 °F) inside.
Whisk the rest of the fish sauce and sugar with the lime juice and 3 tbsp water for the dressing.
Build bowls of noodles, vegetables and herbs, top with sliced chicken and peanuts, and spoon over the dressing.

name: Cá kho tộ (caramelised fish)
description: Fish braised in a sticky caramel and fish-sauce glaze with black pepper, served with rice and greens.
steps: Melt the sugar in a small pot until dark amber, then add the oil, garlic and ⅓ cup water.
Add the fish sauce and fish and simmer gently for 15 minutes, spooning the sauce over, until the fish reaches 63 °C (145 °F).
Finish with pepper and scallions. Serve with rice and bok choy.

name: Gỏi gà (Vietnamese chicken salad)
description: Shredded chicken with cabbage, carrot, herbs and peanuts in a lime and fish sauce dressing.
steps: Poach the chicken for 15 minutes, until it reaches 74 °C (165 °F). Cool and shred.
Mix the lime juice, fish sauce and sugar until dissolved.
Toss the chicken, vegetables and herbs with the dressing. Top with peanuts and serve with rice.

name: Gallo pinto
description: Costa Rica's rice-and-black-bean breakfast, a staple of the Nicoya Blue Zone, with peppers and cilantro.
steps: Cook the onion and pepper in the oil until soft.
Add the beans with a little of their liquid, then fold in the rice until hot and speckled.
Finish with cilantro. Serve with eggs cooked until firm and warm tortillas.

name: Sopa negra (Costa Rican black bean soup)
description: A simple, comforting black bean soup from Costa Rica, served with a sliced hard-boiled egg and rice.
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in the oil.
Add the beans and broth and simmer for 15 minutes. Blend a third of the soup to thicken it.
Serve with sliced egg, cilantro and rice.

name: Avocado & white bean toast with walnuts
description: A plant-forward breakfast in the spirit of Loma Linda's Adventist Blue Zone: beans, avocado, greens and nuts.
steps: Toast the bread. Mash the beans and avocado with the lemon juice.
Spread on the toast and top with spinach, tomato and walnuts.

name: Lentil, quinoa & walnut salad
description: A plant-based lunch in the spirit of Loma Linda's Adventist Blue Zone: lentils, quinoa, greens and walnuts.
steps: Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice with a pinch of salt.
Toss the lentils, quinoa, spinach, tomatoes and cucumber with the dressing.
Top with toasted walnuts.
